patch.value: Native update, comment, and close mutations
Implement update, comments-add, and close in the Rust CLI and SDK, writing canonical .toon items and appending byte-compatible v2 history events matching the published pm 2026.8.21 release.

Rust update writes the same .toon bytes as the published CLI for title, description, status, priority, tags, and body changes;Rust comment appends append the same comment row and comment_add history event bytes;Rust close writes the same status, closed_at, completed_at, and close_reason bytes and close history event;history entries carry item_hash_version 2, canonical patch ordering, and argv-derived agent_provenance role exactly like the published release
